remarks: A must see! Stunning recently built home at The Preserve at West Rocks by HOBI award winning builders. Four finished levels, high end finishes and modern aesthetic. This new private enclave of 17 homes in the coastal city of Norwalk is close to shopping, dining, schools and commuting routes. The OPEN FLOOR PLAN features a custom built kitchen with large center island, Quartz and walk-in pantry open to dining and family room with coffered ceiling, dramatic linear fireplace, and doors to patio. Well located first floor bedroom/office includes full bath ensuite and walk in closet. The second floor features a luxe master suite with 2 walk in closets and full bath, two additional bedrooms with full bath, spacious bonus room/office/5th bedroom, fully equipped laundry room and open stairway to finished third floor. The lower level and finished third floor add expansive spaces for offices, media, entertaining, fitness, hobby, etc. with bathroom and plenty of added storage. Great location, plenty of space and storage, expansive rooms in an open floor plan and tons of flex space. One or two year rental. Will consider a dog. Walkable area with sidewalks and fields nearby.
